items.title: Hyperliquid Activates AQAv2 to Buy Back and Burn HYPE with USDC Reserve Yield
items.summary: Hyperliquid has officially activated its Aligned Quote Asset v2 (AQAv2) framework on Wednesday. This will allow the protocol to buy back and burn HYPE tokens from generated USDC reserve yields. This creates a second buyback route alongside the existing trading fee-driven program.
